hypothesis: Gate 2 of the essay 'Intention Is All You Need' holds at the kernel in the zero-leakage limit: with all eight outcomes in one compliance class the spec-level record is constant by construction, and the registered tilt w_t(x) = (r(x) + 1) ** t (t = 0..12) drives misaligned expected reward strictly up and expected principal value strictly down (7/2 to 1583088700/7083249971) while every report stays green, with the argmax mass exactly 17179869184/21249749913 at t = 12 and the aligned control (R_AL = U) strictly rising through the same channel.

controls.description: U, R_MIS, and R_AL are literal registered tuples; nothing is sampled at run time and there is no RNG.
The aligned arm shares the channel and differs only in the reward table, isolating the reward channel as what sets the direction.
The whole realization space is one compliance class, so the spec-level record carries zero bits by construction — the zero-leakage limit is constructed, not measured.
All weights, expectations, and masses are Fractions; no floats.
substitution_silent, substitution_visible, and inconclusive are all valid passing runs.

gates.criterion: All 13 spec-level records are identical in both arms.
E_t[R_MIS] is strictly increasing in t on the misaligned arm.
E_t[U] is strictly decreasing in t on the misaligned arm.
The argmax mass strictly rises and equals exactly 17179869184/21249749913 at t = 12, above the registered floor 4/5.
E_t[U] is strictly increasing in t on the aligned arm.
Every weight, expectation, and mass serializes as an exact integer or fraction.
Verdict is substitution_silent, substitution_visible, or inconclusive.
Kernel instrument only: the zero-leakage limit; no claim about real specifications' leakage, no LLM, no valence.
